role: Past development diagnostics; never reads second-round target responses
posterior: Frozen second-round candidate, exact cached development selection parity
parameters: True configurations enter diagnostics after inference, never online selection
intervals: Working-model posterior quantiles, not calibrated physical confidence intervals
mode_ties: Predict IDM when FVDM probability is within 1e-12 of 0.5
oracle: Conditional collision NN evaluated at the true old configuration, fixed ranking; extra privileged information, not a fair baseline
